title: Add/remove tiles
description: Insertion handles (+ buttons) between columns, visible on hover. Click → opens adapter picker (mini command palette inline). Delete tile via drawer action or keyboard Delete key. API calls to create/delete nodes, re-layout after mutation.

title: Command palette
description: Cmd+K / Ctrl+K opens a floating search panel. Lists all adapters from API, searchable by name/category. Select adapter → inserts new node after selected tile (or at end). Closes on Escape or selection.

title: Tile selection + detail drawer
description: Click tile → selected state (highlight border, raised shadow). Bottom/right drawer slides open with: adapter config form (generated from configSchema), port list with connection details, label edit. Drawer closes on Escape or clicking canvas.

title: Port interaction + auto-connect
description: Click a port to start a connection drag. Show preview wire following cursor. Drop on compatible port to create edge (API call). Auto-match: when adding a tile, auto-create edges where port types are compatible. Highlight compatible ports during drag.

title: Wire layer (SVG beziers)
description: SVG overlay inside the viewport. For each edge, draw a bezier curve from source port anchor to target port anchor. Color by port type. Wire tokens (width, opacity, dash for mismatch). Recalculates on viewport transform and tile position changes.

title: Render pipeline in viewport
description: Wire together: load pipeline from API → layout engine computes positions → viewport renders StepTiles at computed positions. Tiles are absolutely positioned DOM elements inside the viewport transform container. Pan/zoom works with tiles.

title: Tiling layout engine
description: Given an array of nodes and edges, compute tile positions in a 2D grid. Horizontal columns by topological order. Vertical stacking for fan-out groups. Returns { nodeId, x, y, column, row }[]. Pure function, no DOM — just math. Unit testable.

title: PortBadge component
description: Port name + type color pill. At detail zoom: shows schema fields as key-value type pills. Connected/unconnected visual state. Renders a DOM anchor point for wire attachment (data attribute with port coordinates).

title: StepTile component
description: Single adapter node tile. Category color left border + subtle bg tint. Adapter name, category badge, status dot. Input/output port badges with type colors. LOD: 3 detail levels driven by zoomLevel prop (overview/working/detail). Fixed width, auto height.

title: Zoomable viewport
description: Svelte component wrapping a div with d3-zoom or equivalent. Pan with drag, zoom with scroll/pinch. Exposes zoom level as reactive value. Canvas background with dot grid pattern.

title: Pipeline list page
description: /pipelines route. Card grid of pipelines from API (name, status badge, node count, last updated). Create new button → creates pipeline via API, navigates to editor. Empty state. Filter by status.

title: App shell + navigation
description: Slim sidebar (collapsed icon nav), top toolbar area, main content slot, detail drawer slot. Route layout at (app)/+layout.svelte wrapping authenticated pages. Dark/light theme toggle wired to a store.

title: Design tokens CSS
description: Implement all tokens from DESIGN_TOKENS.md as CSS custom properties in layout.css with @theme block. Dark/light mode via prefers-color-scheme and .dark class. Validate Tailwind picks them up.

title: Epic: Interaction Layer
description: Tile selection, detail drawer, command palette, add/remove tiles, and fan-out group tiles.

title: Epic: Wires & Connections
description: SVG bezier wire layer and port interaction with auto-connect. Makes data flow visible between tiles.

title: Epic: Viewport & Tiles
description: Zoomable viewport, StepTile component, PortBadge, tiling layout engine, and rendering pipeline data in the viewport.

title: Epic: Foundation Layer
description: Design tokens, app shell, navigation, and pipeline list page. The base layer everything else builds on.

title: Schema on ports (TypeBox)
description: Upgrade adapter port definitions to include TypeBox schemas beyond just mime types. Update ManualUploadAdapter. Schema data flows through API → tile PortBadge renders field pills at detail zoom. Backend + frontend change.

title: Schema explorer page
description: /pipelines/:id/schema route. Visual type graph showing each step input/output schemas. Click type → full definition panel. Export buttons: Copy as TypeScript, Download .ts, Copy JSON Schema. Requires adding GET /api/pipelines/:id/schema endpoint.

title: Minimap
description: Small overview panel (bottom-right of viewport). Renders simplified view of full pipeline shape (colored rectangles for tiles, lines for wires). Shows viewport position as draggable rectangle. Click to navigate.

title: Run history page
description: /pipelines/:id/runs route. Table of runs (number, status badge, trigger, started, duration). Click row → run detail. Filter by status. Cancel button for active runs.

title: Adapter catalog page
description: /adapters route. Card grid grouped by category. Each card: name, description, category badge, port count. Click → detail view with full port definitions, config schema docs, usage in pipelines.

title: Asset library page
description: /assets route. Grid of asset cards (thumbnail/icon, name, mime type badge, size). Upload zone (drag-and-drop). Filter by mime type category. Click → asset detail with full preview (image render, text display, JSON tree).

title: Run detail + log drawer
description: /pipelines/:id/runs/:runId route renders same pipeline canvas but read-only with status overlay baked in. Click tile → drawer shows structured logs (from node_runs.logs), input/output asset IDs, timing breakdown, error details.

title: Live tile status overlay
description: During a run, tiles reflect node_run status: pending pulse, running glow border, completed green dot + duration badge, failed red border + inline error. Status transitions animate using animation tokens. Skipped tiles dim.

title: Run trigger + status bar
description: Run button in toolbar. Calls POST /pipelines/:id/run. Status bar appears at bottom: run ID, progress dots, elapsed time, overall status. Polls GET /runs/:runId on interval for updates.

title: Fan-out (group tile)
description: Add parallel branch action on tile output port context menu. Creates GroupTile container in next column. GroupTile stacks child StepTiles vertically. Layout engine handles group sizing. Edges fan from source to each child.

title: Epic: Polish & Schema
description: Minimap, schema explorer page, TypeBox schemas on ports. Refinement and the schema-first features.

title: Epic: Supporting Pages
description: Asset library, adapter catalog, and run history pages. Secondary views supporting the core editor.

title: Epic: Run Observation
description: Run trigger, live tile status overlay, run detail page with log drawer. Makes pipeline execution observable.
